english_title: Convolution with a Smooth Function Yields Smoothness
statement_en:
If $f \in L^1$, $g\in C^k$, and $\partial^{\alpha} g$ is bounded for every multi-index $\alpha$ with $|\alpha|\leq k$, then
$$f*g\in C^k$$
and
$$\partial^{\alpha}\left(f*g\right)=f*\partial^{\alpha}g.$$
callout_body: 如果函数$f \in L^1,g\in C^k$并且$\partial^{\alpha} g$有界($\alpha$是多重指标，$|\alpha|\leq k$)那么$$f*g\in C^k$$并且$$\partial^{\alpha}\left(f*g\right)=f*\partial^{\alpha}g$$
